lines.text: An Israelite woman's son, whose father is Egyptian, curses the Name, and they bring him to Moses.
His mother Shelomith is of the tribe of Asher, and they place him in custody.
The LORD tells Moses that all who heard him are to lay their hands on his head.
Killing an animal requires restitution, but killing a man requires death, and an injury is repaid in kind.
The LORD sets one standard of law for foreign resident and native, and the Israelites burn the blasphemer.
